sn12.57:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā … saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati
sn12.57:2.2: tassa puriso kālena kālaṃ mūlāni palisajjeyya kālena kālaṃ paṃsuṃ dadeyya kālena kālaṃ udakaṃ dadeyya
sn12.57:2.3: evañhi so bhikkhave taruṇo rukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya
sn12.57:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave saññojaniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati
sn12.57:3.1: saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati
sn12.57:3.3: evame tassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti.
sn12.57:4.2: atha puriso āgac cheyya kuddālapiṭakaṃ ādāya …pe…
sn12.57:4.4: evañhi so bhikkhave taruṇo rukkho ucchinnamūlo assa tālā vatthukato anabhāvaṅgato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo
sn12.57:4.5: evameva kho bhikkhave saññojaniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati
